rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the chemical element or carbon as a material.

example.english: This piece of graphite is mainly composed of carbon.
example.traditional: 呢塊石墨主要係由碳組成。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 sek6 mak6 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 jau4 taan3 zou2 sing4

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to an individual carbon atom in a molecule.

example.english: There are several carbon atoms in this molecule.
example.traditional: 呢個分子入面有幾個碳原子。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fan1 zi2 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 go3 taan3 jyun4 zi2
